title: Aggregate measurement completeness is schema-guaranteed with explicit NOT_CAPTURED reasons

findings: W12's aggregate is prose-shaped by section (matrix/provider/investigation/...) with no required-metric schema, so a missing metric is invisible.
providerFailuresByClass: W12 recorded only a partial two-class breakdown inside its provider section, not a contract-bound taxonomy distribution.
providerRetries: recorded as the string "NOT_CAPTURED" without a schema field or a sanctioned reason.
providerTransitions: absent entirely because only one provider was frozen.
transport/tool byte accounting and termination distributions were present but not enforceably required.

floorIntegration: A truncated source population composes with R-05: a metric whose population is TRUNCATED must be FLOOR, and the R-06 test proves an EXACT denominator over the truncated population is rejected.
